sourceProvenance.geometryOrigin: Original parametric standalone shirt geometry; provenance states no source outfit geometry or UVs were reused.

garmentTypeAndCoverage.observation: The four views read as a standalone long-sleeve shirt with a front placket, buttons, collar pieces, and cuff buttons; no mannequin or body is visible.

silhouetteAndVolume.observation: The torso and sleeves have readable volume from all angles; the correction preserves the regular-fit standalone silhouette.

shoulderJoins.observation: The back capture still shows dark gaps at both shoulder/sleeve joins; the oblique view shows a dark opening at the outer shoulder as well.

collarConstruction.observation: The front still reads as a small cylindrical stand with angular, separated leaves and a central strip; the parts do not read as a clean, joined office-shirt collar.

naturalFabricFolds.observation: The revised torso now shows restrained drape at the waist and lower panels in the front and oblique views; this reads adequately for a pressed office shirt without distorting the silhouette.

findings.observation: Dark open-looking gaps remain at both joins in the back view; a dark opening is also visible at the outer shoulder in oblique view.
findings.expected: Create a continuous shoulder/armhole transition between back panel and sleeves with no visible gap or stray surface.

findings.observation: The stand and pointed leaves still look separated and angular; the front view does not read as a joined office-shirt collar.
findings.expected: Join the stand and leaves into a proportionate, recognizable shirt collar that sits cleanly on the neckline and front panels.

summary: Retest độc lập ATEL-47/v2: SHAPE-03 đã đạt với nếp drape nhẹ, phù hợp áo sơ mi công sở; silhouette/volume và các chi tiết tay dài, khuy trước/cổ tay đạt, không mannequin. SHAPE-01 và SHAPE-02 vẫn chưa đạt: còn khe tối ở hai mối vai sau và cổ chưa liền/đọc rõ thành cổ sơ mi. Hash cả 11 artifact khớp manifest. Đây là retest tập trung của correction; chưa pass shape và không chuyển Material.
